scripts.name: Prepare worktree
scripts.command: bun install && omni remote-sources install && omni projection sync && omni ignore sync && { [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/AGENTS.md" ] && [ ! -e AGENTS.md ] && cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/AGENTS.md" AGENTS.md || true; } && { [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.agents/agent-choices.local.md" ] && [ ! -e .agents/agent-choices.local.md ] && mkdir -p .agents && cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.agents/agent-choices.local.md" .agents/agent-choices.local.md || true; }
